title: Kapunan: Were VP Duterte’s earlier bank balances declared?

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bank balances in Vice President Sara Duterte’s accounts that were later withdrawn would not show whether she correctly declared the money she allegedly held in previous years, private prosecutor Lorna Kapunan said on Tuesday in an interview on ANC’s “Headstart.” Kapunan challenged a hypothetical defense explanation that money could have passed through an account but was no longer there when the year-end asset declaration was prepared. “Did she declare it the year before?” Kapunan asked. She pointed to the prosecution’s explanation about why balances had gone undeclared in earlier years. READ: Unexplained wealth of VP may hit P1.5 billion, […]...
